Welcome to Al-Shifa Chiropractic & Physiotherapy Channel! Mohammad Mostafizur Rahman (DC, registered chiropractor in Australia graduated from Murdoch University, Australia) here, and I am going to post videos about different health related topics including but not limited to back, neck, shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, ankle pain and conditions which can cause muscle and joint pain and their treatments. 

Clinic address: 35/G Bashbari Rd (ground floor, left side) (Mondirer goli), Mohammadpur, Dhaka 1207. For appointment call 01750508121 / text on WhatsApp at 01786278931.
